error_device_not_configured: Set the terminal IP address first
error_device_unreachable: Cannot reach the terminal. Check the IP, the cable and the comm key.
error_device_read: Connected, but reading from the terminal failed
error_duplicate_device_user: That device user is already mapped to another employee
device_subtitle: ZKTeco device on the local network
device_comm_key_hint: Leave blank for the default (0), or match the key set on the device
device_use_tcp_hint: Turn off for older firmware that only answers on UDP
device_skip_ping_hint: Turn on if the network blocks ICMP but port 4370 is open
device_not_configured_hint: Enter the terminal IP address to get started
device_sync_clock: Set device clock from this PC
device_mapping_hint: Each employee needs the user ID they are enrolled under on the terminal
backup_hint: All data lives on this PC. Keep a copy somewhere else.
report_no_rows: No attendance in this range. Sync the terminal, or widen the dates.
report_pdf_saved: PDF saved to your Documents, under GuardSync Reports
schedule_hint: Every arrival, departure and overtime hour is judged against these.
schedule_work_hint: Arriving after the start is late; leaving before the end is an early leave. Housing staff finish half an hour earlier.
schedule_overtime_hint: Time on site between the end of the day and the overtime hour is not paid as overtime. Nothing past the closing hour is counted, so a forgotten scan cannot read as a night's work.
schedule_invalid: The day must end after it starts, overtime must start no earlier than the end of the day, and stop after it starts.
schedule_refresh_hint: Days already synced keep their old figures until you refresh the punch report, which re-reads the punches under the new hours.
report_csv_copied: Report copied — paste into a spreadsheet
report_monthly_failed: Could not write the monthly report
report_correct_warning: One correction only, and only on the day itself. Once saved it cannot be changed again, and a device sync will not overwrite it.
report_correct_used: This day's correction has been used
report_correct_closed: The window has closed — the same day only
error_correction_used: This day has already been corrected
error_correction_not_today: A day can only be corrected on the day itself
error_correction_empty: Enter a check-in or a check-out time
error_correction_time: That is not a valid time
device_import_employees_hint: Create an employee for anyone enrolled on the terminal but missing here
device_match_review_hint: These terminal users share a name with someone already on file. Nothing has been added or linked for them yet — their punches are being kept and will be applied once you answer.
employee_match_banner_title: {} device users are waiting on you
employee_match_banner_hint: They share a name with someone already here, so the sync did not add them. Their punches are being kept until you say who they are.
error_enroll_needs_name: Enter the employee's name first — the terminal needs it to create the user
error_enroll_start_failed: The terminal refused to start enrolment. Make sure nobody else is using it.
error_enroll_no_template: No fingerprint stored yet. Finish the scan on the terminal, then press Done.
error_device_write_failed: Could not write the user to the terminal
enroll_place_finger_hint: The device is asking for a finger. Press it on the sensor until the device confirms — usually three times — then press Done here.
delete_also_removes_fingerprint: This also removes their fingerprint from the terminal. They would need to enrol again.
delete_device_unreachable: Employee deleted, but the terminal could not be reached — their fingerprint is still enrolled on the device.
error_device_delete_failed: The terminal refused to remove the user
device_live_sync_hint: Record each punch the moment the terminal accepts a finger, instead of waiting for the timer
import_columns_hint: Any sheet with a header row — only the name column is required.
import_template_hint: An empty sheet with the column headings the import understands.
import_no_rows: That sheet has headings but no employees under them
import_no_name_column: No name column found. The sheet needs a header row with a column such as "Full name" or "الاسم".
import_unreadable_file: Could not read that file. Open it in Excel, save it as .xlsx and try again.
import_unsupported_file: Only .xlsx files can be read. Save the file as .xlsx and try again.
device_fetch_hint: Add everyone enrolled on the fingerprint terminal, and renumber the list so it runs in one sequence
device_fetch_done: Staff list updated from the terminal
clash_hint: These employees answer to the same name, so the list cannot tell them apart. Give one of them a name that can — nothing else about them changes.
clash_certainly_distinct: Both are enrolled on the terminal under different fingerprints, so these are certainly different people.
clash_may_be_same: Only one of them is enrolled on the terminal. If this is the same person twice, delete the one without a fingerprint.
restore_title: These people were deleted here before
restore_hint: The terminal listed {} people, and {} of them were deleted from this app before. They were not added back, because a deletion has to survive the next sync. Tick anyone who should come back — their old punches will be applied to them again.
departments_hint: The list an employee's department is chosen from. Leave it empty if everyone here works in one place — the form still offers “No department”.
department_unlisted: In use, not on the list yet
departments_empty_hint: Add the departments your staff work in, or leave this empty and file everyone under “No department”.
department_delete_msg: This removes it from the list.
department_delete_moves: {} employees are in it. They will be left with no department — nobody is deleted.
error_department_exists: There is already a department with this name
shifts_hint: A shift is one working day the company runs. Each employee is judged by the shift they are on — leave the list empty and everybody keeps the default work hours.
shift_grace_hint: Accept late in is how many minutes past the start someone may arrive without the day counting as late. Accept early out is how many minutes before the end they may leave without it counting as an early leave.
shifts_empty_hint: Add one for each set of start and end times the company works. Until then everybody is judged by the default work hours.
shift_delete_msg: This removes it from the list.
shift_delete_moves: {} employees are on it. They will go back to the default work hours — nobody is deleted.
error_shift_exists: There is already a shift with this name
error_shift_invalid_hours: The shift must end after it starts, and the two allowances must not cover the whole day between them.
error_shift_required: Choose a shift for this employee
confirm_identity_correction: Enter the password of the signed-in account to save this correction. A day's punches can only be corrected once, and the correction is recorded under your name.
rest_days_hint: The days this schedule does not work. Nobody is judged late or absent on them, and work done on one is marked as a rest-day shift.
rest_days_none: No rest days — works every day
holidays_hint: Dates nobody in the company was expected to work. They apply to every shift, and a holiday landing on a rest day is named as the holiday.
holidays_empty_hint: Add the company's public holidays and shutdowns. Until then every date except a weekly rest day counts as a working day.
holiday_delete_msg: These dates go back to being ordinary working days.
error_holiday_invalid_range: The last day must be on or after the first day
